fine_lines.title: this vs that
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان للمفرد. this للشيء القريب منك (هذا/هذه). that للشيء البعيد عنك (ذلك/تلك). وبعدهما is.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both are for one thing. This is for something near you. That is for something far from you. Both take is.

fine_lines.title: these vs those
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان للجمع. these للأشياء القريبة (هؤلاء)، those للأشياء البعيدة (أولئك). وبعدهما are.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both are for more than one thing. These is for things near you. Those is for things far from you. Both take are.

fine_lines.title: this vs these
fine_lines.explanation_ar: this لشيء واحد قريب ويأتي بعده is. these لعدة أشياء قريبة ويأتي بعدها are.
fine_lines.explanation_en: This is for one near thing + is. These is for many near things + are.

fine_lines.title: pen vs pencil
fine_lines.explanation_ar: pen قلم حبر أو جاف لا يُمسح. pencil قلم رصاص يمكن مسحه بالممحاة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A pen writes with ink. A pencil is wooden and you can erase what it writes.

grammar.title: Demonstratives: this / that
grammar.explanation_ar: this و that ضمائر إشارة للمفرد. this للقريب و that للبعيد. يأتي بعدهما is لأنهما للمفرد. يمكن أن نضع بعدهما الاسم مباشرة: this flower (هذه الزهرة). ويمكن أيضًا استخدام it بدلًا منهما.
grammar.explanation_en: This and that point to one thing. This = near, that = far. They take is. We can put a noun right after them: this flower. We can also use it.

grammar.title: Demonstratives: these / those
grammar.explanation_ar: these و those للجمع. these للقريب و those للبعيد. يأتي بعدهما are، والاسم بعدهما يكون جمعًا بدون a/an.
grammar.explanation_en: These and those point to more than one thing. These = near, those = far. They take are, and the noun after them is plural with no a/an.

grammar.title: Two-part things are plural
grammar.explanation_ar: الأشياء المكونة من جزأين متشابهين تُعامل كجمع: pants, glasses, shoes, socks. لذلك نقول these/those و are.
grammar.explanation_en: Things with two matching parts are plural: pants, glasses, shoes, socks. So we use these/those and are.

grammar.title: Asking with What
grammar.explanation_ar: what تعني ما/ماذا. للمفرد: What is this/that? والإجابة: It's a ... . للجمع: What are these/those? والإجابة: They're ... . علامة الاستفهام (?) في آخر السؤال.
grammar.explanation_en: What asks about things. Singular: What is this/that? → It's a ... . Plural: What are these/those? → They're ... . Put a question mark (?) at the end.
examples: What is this? It's a ball.
What is that? It's a pen.

grammar.title: Colors before nouns
grammar.explanation_ar: في الإنجليزية يأتي اللون (الصفة) قبل الاسم: a red pen (قلم أحمر). الألوان صفات فلا تُجمع ولا نضع قبلها a/an إذا جاءت وحدها: It's green وليس It's a green. وللسؤال عن اللون: What color is/are ...?
grammar.explanation_en: In English the color (adjective) comes before the noun: a red pen. Colors are adjectives, so they have no plural (orange, not oranges) and no a/an when alone: It's green. To ask: What color is/are ...?
examples: a yellow shirt, a black T-shirt
What color is the lime? It's green.
What color are the carrots? They're orange.

questions.question: The book is in your hand. You say: "___ is a book."
The stars are in the sky. "___ are stars."

questions.question: "What color is the eggplant?"
questions.explanation_ar: الألوان صفات: لا تُجمع ولا نضع قبلها a.
questions.explanation_en: Colors are adjectives: no a and no plural.

questions.question: "___ pants are blue."
questions.explanation_ar: pants جمع لأنها من جزأين، فنستخدم these.
questions.explanation_en: Pants is plural (two legs), so we use these.

questions.question: What is "مسطرة" in English?

questions.explanation_en: The color comes before the noun, and yellow starts with a consonant: a.
